subject: VM artifacts for M&A diligence — digest & attestation
messages:
From: Michael Jones <michael.jones@acquirerco.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, acq-due-diligence@acquirerco.com
Cc: Sara Choi <sara.choi@acquirerco.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: VM artifacts request for diligence

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. As part of AcquirerCo's security diligence for the deal team, could you provide a compact digest of your Vulnerability Management (VM) artifacts that we can include in our data room? Specifically we need: 

- High-level scan cadence (internal and third-party) and evidence of recent scans (last 90 days)
- CVE remediation SLA commitments and a representative closure matrix for critical/high findings
- Any SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ references that tie VM outputs to your controls

Our timeline is compact — if possible, can we get a digest and an attestation by end-of-day today PST, or EOD Monday latest? If there are any contractual or redaction constraints, flag them and we'll limit distribution.

Thanks,
Michael
Michael Jones
M&A Security Lead, AcquirerCo
acquirerco.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Michael Jones <michael.jones@acquirerco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: VM artifacts request for diligence

Michael —

Appreciate the note and the timeline. We'll put together a concise packet that covers: scan cadence (internal weekly scans + monthly third-party), recent scan artifacts (we'll include proofs from the last 90 days), our CVE triage + SLA matrix, and a short attestation connecting these items to our SOC 2 control mapping.

Quick clarifying Qs so we scope precisely:
- Is the primary audience your security engineering diligence team (technical), or the legal/exec reviewers (higher-level attestation)?
- Do you need raw scan exports (Nmap/Qualys/Snyk outputs) or a redacted proof bundle?

Laura (copied) will lead the attestation text. Kimberly will pull the supporting artifacts and upload a zipped digest to the Drive link below. We anticipate: 

- Draft digest uploaded in ~3 hours (by 1:15pm PST)
- Formal attestation PDF signed by Laura by EOD (or Monday if your team prefers additional review)

I will also include a short CSV mapping critical CVEs to remediation owners and closure dates — thats in the CVE closure matrix. If that works, we'll proceed and flag anything that must be redacted.

Drive upload (incoming): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqV-ExampleDriveLink
HubSpot reference (deal): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/ACQ-2026-041

Thanks — Sean

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Michael Jones <michael.jones@acquirerco.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 16:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: VM artifacts request for diligence

Michael / team —

Attached is the compact VM evidence packet we prepared for the AcquirerCo data room, plus a formal attestation below. Attachments: VM-evidence-digest.zip (redacted scan proofs and index), CVE-closure-matrix.xlsx (representative rows for recent critical/high), SOC2-vm-summary.pdf (control mapping).

Key points from the packet (summary):
- Scan cadence: internal automated host/application scans run weekly; dynamic/DAST and dependency scans run nightly for active services. Third-party authenticated scans are performed monthly; full external penetration tests are performed quarterly.
- SLA: Critical CVEs (CVSS >=9.0) — response acknowledged within 24 hours, mitigation plan within 72 hours, closure target 14 days unless compensating control documented; High (7.0–8.9) — acknowledged 72 hours, closure target 30 days. These SLAs are enforced via our incident workflow and tracked in SEC-7421 (Jira).
- Recent evidence: redacted Qualys and Snyk outputs from the last 90 days; scan index includes timestamps and artifact hashes.
- Remediation ownership: each row in the supplied CVE-closure-matrix shows owner, target remediation date, actual closure date, rollback plan (if any), and links to PR/patch tickets.

Attestation (signed by Head of Security):

"I, Laura Bennett, Head of Security at Redwood Inference, attest that the attached VM evidence package accurately represents Redwood's vulnerability management program as of the date signed. The scan cadence, triage procedures, SLA commitments, and remediation matrix included reflect our operational practices and controls that are mapped to the relevant SOC 2/SIG control objectives. Artifacts have been redacted to protect customer data and internal-only secrets. For any additional verification requests (raw logs, hash verification, or on-site review), please coordinate via the AcquirerCo diligence mailbox."

Signed,
Laura Bennett
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

-- Attachment stubs --
VM-evidence-digest.zip (zip) — index.txt, redacted-qualys-report.pdf, snyk-summary.csv, scan-index.json
CVE-closure-matrix.xlsx (xlsx) — sample rows only, full sheet contains internal ticket links
SOC2-vm-summary.pdf (pdf) — mapping of VM outputs to SOC 2 control IDs

If you'd like, we can add a short notarized attestation or an expanded audit binder for legal review — let me know which you prefer.

Laura
